reasoning_traces.think:
The DS-Agent framework formalizes automated data science through a structured CBR loop: retrieve relevant past cases, reuse them as templates, revise based on feedback, and retain improved versions. This process defines p_CBR(y^t|τ) as a marginal distribution over solutions, incorporating both retrieval and LLM generation dynamics. Feedback inference p_E(l^t|τ) aggregates over possible solutions to yield a probabilistic assessment of outcome quality. The key innovation lies in the iterative refinement enabled by feedback, which allows the system to avoid generating unreasonable experiment plans—addressing the core limitation of LLM agents. The two-stage design separates expensive development cycles (nightly) from cheap deployment runs (weekly), aligning with GSE's operational cadence. The formalism supports both exploration and exploitation, with the revise-and-retain mechanism ensuring that the case bank evolves toward better solutions over time.
